description: This Java source file defines the JType class, which maps C types to Java types for OpenGL and EGL interop, including handling of primitive types, buffers, and EGL handles.

classes.name: JType
classes.description: Represents Java types corresponding to C types, with methods for type conversion, buffer handling, and type introspection.

methods.name: getBaseType
methods.description: Returns the base Java type as a string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the type, including array notation if applicable.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the type is an array.

methods.name: isClass
methods.description: Checks if the type is a class type.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the type is a String.

methods.name: isPrimitive
methods.description: Checks if the type is a primitive type.

methods.name: isVoid
methods.description: Checks if the type is void.

methods.name: isBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the type is a Buffer type.

methods.name: isTypedBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the type is a typed Buffer.

methods.name: getArrayTypeForTypedBuffer
methods.description: Returns the array type corresponding to a typed Buffer.

methods.name: getArrayGetterForPrimitiveArray
methods.description: Returns the getter method name for primitive arrays.

methods.name: getArrayReleaserForPrimitiveArray
methods.description: Returns the releaser method name for primitive arrays.

methods.name: isEGLHandle
methods.description: Checks if the type is an EGL handle.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a CType to a JType, optionally using array mapping.
